name: Shopify
difficultyLabel: Harder — BYO required + Partner app review for public apps

timeEstimate.setupHours: 2–5 hours for Partner account, app create, scopes, and Composio wiring
timeEstimate.approvalWait: Custom/unpublished apps for your own stores: often none beyond install. Public apps distributed via Shopify App Store: app review measured in business days to weeks depending on complexity and revisions
timeEstimate.calendarTotal: Days for a custom app on stores you control; weeks if you need App Store distribution

summary: Shopify is listed under Composio’s Bring-your-own OAuth apps — there is no Composio-managed Shopify OAuth shortcut. You must create a Shopify app (Partner Dashboard), configure OAuth redirect, and supply client credentials. Public App Store distribution adds review; installing on stores you administer is a faster path.
whenYouNeedThis: Your agent needs Shopify toolkit access in Composio — BYO is mandatory
You are connecting merchant stores via OAuth
You plan to list publicly in the Shopify App Store (extra review path)
prerequisites: Clear API scopes (Admin API access scopes)
App listing materials + privacy policy if submitting to the App Store
Composio project to store client ID/secret

steps.title: Confirm managed auth is unavailable
steps.detail: Composio’s managed OAuth directory lists Shopify under Bring your own OAuth app. Plan credentials from day one.

steps.title: Create a Partner app
steps.detail: Shopify Partners → Apps → Create app. Choose the app distribution model that matches your product (custom vs public).

steps.title: Configure OAuth redirect URLs
steps.detail: Add https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback to Allowed redirection URLs / auth callback settings for your app version.

steps.title: Select Admin API scopes
steps.detail: Request least-privilege scopes for the agent’s tools. Excess scopes slow App Store review.

steps.title: Copy API key and secret into Composio
steps.detail: Create Shopify OAuth2 custom auth config with client ID/secret from the Partner Dashboard.

steps.title: Install on a development store and test
steps.detail: Complete OAuth install, verify token exchange via Composio connection, exercise read/write tools safely.

steps.title: Only then pursue App Store review
steps.detail: If merchants must discover you in the App Store, submit for app review with demo credentials and compliance docs.

blockers: No Composio managed app — blocked until Partner credentials exist
App Store review rejections for missing GDPR/privacy flows, webhooks, or unjustified scopes
Custom app distribution limits which stores can install
nuances: “Works on my development store” is not the same as “approved public app.”
Shopify auth has evolved (session tokens, token exchange); follow current shopify.dev auth docs for your app type.
Protected customer data access may require additional approval tiers.
agentCanDo: Confirm BYO-required status from Composio’s directory
Draft redirect URI + scope minimization checklist
Outline custom vs public distribution tradeoffs
Link official Shopify auth and app review docs
humanMustDo: Configure redirect URLs and scopes in Partner Dashboard
Provide review notes / demo store access for App Store submission
nextAction: Create a Shopify Partner app and development store first — you cannot skip BYO for this toolkit. Defer App Store submission until OAuth + Composio connection works on a dev store.

notes: SHOPIFY requires bring-your-own OAuth credentials in Composio.
Create custom auth config before users can connect stores.

sources.title: Composio managed OAuth apps (BYO list includes Shopify)

evidenceNotes: BYO requirement verified from Composio managed-auth directory (Shopify under Bring your own).
Auth and app review steps grounded in shopify.dev docs; exact App Store SLA varies.
